response.overview: Scholastic Classics, a new value line, continues with a SING-ALONG release packed with 20 tales perfect for kids and families who love to watch classic storybooks come to life! The full list of stories includes: The Wheels on the Bus, Chicka Chicka 123, Musical Max, Bugs, Bugs, Bugs, He s Got the World in His Hands, Giraffes Can t Dance, Zin! Zin! Zin! A Violin, The Star-Spangled Banner, This Land is Your Land, The Ant and the Grasshopper, Duke Ellington, All the Colors of the Earth, Ella Fitzgerald: The Tale of A Vocal Virtuosa, Joseph Had a Little Overcoat, Changes, Changes, Keeping House, The Foolish Frog, Jazztime, Waiting for Wings, Patrick
response.title: Storybook Treasures: 20 Sing-Along Stories
